children: A Hyperliquid address, 0xefe4c0...194b, increased its BTC long position by 311.65 BTC, according to monitoring data from Liquid24/7.xyz. According to ChainCatcher, the address now holds 486.6 BTC in long positions after the addition.

The position has a notional value of about $41.11 million. At the time of reporting, BTC was trading near $84,486, while the average entry price for the long position was about $85,974, leaving an unrealized loss of roughly $724,100.

title: Hyperliquid Address Adds 311.65 BTC Long Positions
